name: ui-reverse-engineering
title: UI Reverse Engineering — capture → analyze → rebuild
summary: Reverse-engineer a live website's UI/UX with Playwright (HTML, CSS, screenshots desktop+mobile, assets, behavior), distill a design system, and rebuild it as clean React + Vite + Tailwind + shadcn/ui components. Rebuild the LAYOUT and UX, never a literal copy — refactor, componentize, improve a11y/responsiveness. Legally-gated: only sites you own or are authorized to rebuild (redesign, migration, inspiration).
mandatory_tests: Authorization confirmed: the source site is owned by the user or rebuild is authorized (redesign/migration/inspiration) — recorded in the Brain
No literal HTML/CSS copy shipped: output is refactored, componentized code
Third-party assets (logos, fonts, copyrighted images/copy, trademarks) are NOT reused without a license — replaced or flagged
Rebuilt UI meets the a11y baseline (semantic HTML, contrast, focus, keyboard) and is responsive (desktop + mobile captured and matched)
validations: Capture is complete: HTML, CSS, screenshots (desktop + mobile), assets, fonts, SVG/icons, links, and key interactions
A design system was extracted (colors, typography, spacing scale, radii, shadows, components) before any code
Components are reusable and named by role (Header, Nav, Hero, Features, Card, Form, Footer), not pixel-cloned
Improvements proposed where the original is weak (a11y, responsiveness, performance, semantics)
Clean code: no dead markup, no inline style dumps, tokens over magic numbers
Provenance recorded: source URL(s), capture date, and the authorization basis
